index_snapshot.definition: CREATE INDEX listings_primary_active_idx ON public.listings USING btree (is_primary_listing, is_active, last_seen_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX listings_duplicate_of_idx ON public.listings USING btree (duplicate_of_listing_id)
CREATE INDEX listings_image_status_idx ON public.listings USING btree (image_status, image_last_checked_at, last_seen_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX listings_seen_idx ON public.listings USING btree (first_seen_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX listings_active_idx ON public.listings USING btree (is_active, last_seen_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX listings_enrichment_status_idx ON public.listings USING btree (enrichment_status, enrichment_checked_at, last_seen_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX listings_cross_hash_idx ON public.listings USING btree (cross_source_hash) WHERE (cross_source_hash IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX listings_match_idx ON public.listings USING btree (warm_rent, rooms, area_sqm)
CREATE INDEX listings_quality_status_idx ON public.listings USING btree (quality_status, enrichment_delivery_eligible, is_active, last_seen_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX listings_dedupe_group_idx ON public.listings USING btree (dedupe_group_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX listings_pkey ON public.listings USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX listings_source_id_source_listing_key_key ON public.listings USING btree (source_id, source_listing_key)
